title: TimeBound (TimeDrain SMP)
description: A fun server plugin based off of the TimeDrain SMP, where each player has a timer they need to try and keep from hitting zero.
body:
THIS PLUGIN IS HEAVILY INSPIRED BY THE PLUGIN FOUND ON THE TIMEDRAIN SMP. Credit to [Wrld](https://www.youtube.com/@whereswrld) for the idea.

If you find any bugs or glitches within the plugin please feel free to let me know via my discord!

Description
-

Each player is given their own timer. They must try their best to keep it above zero at all times. If their clock hits zero they are BANNED. Players can gain time by killing mobs and mining ores. By default, passive mobs give you 1 minute of time and hostile mobs give you 3 minutes. The time ores give you varies depending on how hard they are to find.

Commands:
-
All players (no perms needed):

- `/timebound help` - Shows a list of commands with info for each one

- `/timebound status` - Shows your time status. (eg. running/paused, time remaining, other configured values

- `/timebound transfer <player> <time>` - Players can use this command to transfer time between each other.

Admin only (op needed):

- `/timebound config <reset | set | get | list> [key] [value]` - Admins can use this command to configure the plugin in game, in real time. More information about each configurable setting can be found in the plugins config file.

- `/timebound timers <start | stop | reset | status>` - Admins can use this command to manage all of the players timers.

- `/timebound time <add | remove | set | get> <player> <amount>` - Control individual players timers with add, remove, and set utilities.

- `/timebound unban <player>` - Unban a player and reset their timer to 15 minutes (or the default configured time)
